title: attestation: Add the TDX family specification and generated files
overview: Declares the ctlv-attestation-tdx family (ID 2), a child of ctlv-attestation that fills the device-info extension point with TDX-specific measurement IDs. The YAML spec is the source; the ABI snapshot, registries and the three generated files (UAPI header, kernel header, kernel source) are derived from it. The generated descriptor references provider hooks that patch 20 implements.

files.purpose: Checked-in ABI snapshot of the family written by `make -C tools/ctlv abi-update`; the checker compares the live spec against it so UAPI changes are reviewed.

units.title: ABI snapshot
units.summary: Pins family ID 2, the info group with three 48-byte binary attrs, and the device-info fill.
units.details: Attribute IDs 1-3 and the fixed length 48 are frozen here; removing or renumbering them would be an ABI break.

files.purpose: Append-only central registry whose order assigns family IDs.

units.title: Register ctlv-attestation-tdx
units.summary: Appends the family third in the list, giving it ID 2.

files.purpose: List of families the generator tooling builds.

units.title: Add family to build list
units.summary: Makes the tools process the new spec.

files.purpose: Maps each family spec to the generated files that must stay in sync.

units.title: TDX family outputs
units.summary: Declares spec source and the UAPI header, kernel header and kernel source output paths.

files.purpose: Source specification of the TDX family from which all generated files come.

units.title: Family and info group
units.summary: Declares a pre-init family inheriting ctlv-attestation with an `info` group of mrconfigid, mrowner and mrownerconfig.
units.details: Each attribute is a binary of exactly 48 bytes (min-length equals max-length), matching the TDX report fields.  `pre-init: true` means a pre_init hook supplies the provider before init.

units.title: device-info fill
units.summary: Fills the base family's device-info extension point with the three info attributes.

files.purpose: Generated kernel source: schema tables and the family descriptor. Every symbol it references that is not generated (op_pre/post, priv lifecycle, device_info_fill) is supplied by providers/tdx.c. Compiled with _CTLV_GENERATED_METADATA_ONLY so only metadata is emitted.

units.title: Header and includes
units.details: Defining the metadata-only macro hides the accessor helpers that the kernel header otherwise emits.

units.title: Fill node schema
units.summary: Validation schema for the device-info fill: a root node and three 48-byte binary leaves.

units.title: Stub fill and family schema
units.summary: Binds the fill schema to the parent's device-info set and defines the family schema with ID 2.

units.title: Uevent limits
units.summary: Compile-time checks that the chain's uevent cost fits the core limits.

units.title: Stub ops and family descriptor
units.summary: Wires the device_info fill callback and the lifecycle and op hooks into the exported `ctlv_attestation_tdx_family`.
units.details: The parent is `ctlv_attestation_family`; ctlv_create() consumes this descriptor, as called from the provider in patch 20.

files.purpose: Generated kernel header declaring the hooks the provider must implement, and typed accessors for the fill's attributes.

units.summary: Include guard, includes and the base family's generated header.

units.details: These are the symbols implemented in drivers/attestation/providers/tdx.c.

units.title: Input accessors

units.title: Reply put helpers

files.purpose: Generated UAPI header giving userspace the group and attribute IDs of the family; includes the parent's header so one include covers the effective schema.

units.title: Header and includes

units.title: Info attribute IDs
units.summary: Builds full attribute IDs from family, group and attr number: enum values 1-3 and public CTLV_ATTESTATION_TDX_ATTR_INFO_* macros.

files.purpose: Generated enum of family IDs, in registry order.
